versions.subject: fix: add missing quotes and OriginalFileName field
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\wmic.exe'
        - '\vssadmin.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
        - 'wmic.exe'
        - 'VSSADMIN.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'shadow'
        - 'create'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\wmic.exe", "*\\vssadmin.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll", "wmic.exe", "VSSADMIN.EXE") CommandLine="*shadow*" CommandLine="*create*"
